verdict.rationale: Workable's own docs confirm an offer object per candidate. The MCP server description says it covers the hiring lifecycle "through offer approvals" and lets users "manage offers", and offers can be translated into nine languages. This shows offers are handled in the ATS with some approval step, but depth is thin. missing for 10: templated offer letters with dynamic fields, documented approval routing configuration, built-in e-signature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, offers go out from the ATS — templated offer letters with dynamic fields, approval routing, and built-in e-signature

citations.quote: It covers the entire hiring lifecycle — from job management and candidate sourcing through offer approvals
Calling the `/candidates/:id/offer` endpoint returns a JSON array of the candidate's latest offer.
Translate job posts, applications, and offers into nine languages
